name: InstaDownload
subtitle: Save Instagram reels & posts to your device
description: Official AltStore source for InstaDownload, an open-source, no-account Instagram downloader for iOS.

apps.name: InstaDownload
apps.subtitle: Save reels & posts to your device
apps.localizedDescription:
InstaDownload saves public Instagram reels, photos and carousels straight to your photo library or a folder in Files.

• Paste a link, the preview loads on its own
• Saves videos, single photos and full carousels
• No account, no login, no tracking, no ads
• Liquid Glass interface built for iOS 26
• Light, dark and system themes

InstaDownload only downloads public content. Stories and private posts are served by Instagram to logged-in accounts only, so they can't be fetched here.

Open source under the GPL: github.com/Orang-Studio/InstaDownload

versions.localizedDescription: First iOS release. Rebuilt in SwiftUI with Apple's Liquid Glass design language, saving to the photo library or a folder you choose in Files.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: InstaDownload saves the reels and photos you download straight into your photo library.
